exams.name: Military Competence Instructor Knowledge Test
exams.blurb: 125-question test for military instructor pilots seeking a civilian flight instructor certificate on the basis of service experience.

exams.name: Private Pilot Airplane Canadian Conversion Knowledge Test
exams.blurb: 40-question test converting a Canadian private pilot aeroplane licence into an FAA private pilot certificate.

exams.name: Private Pilot Airplane Knowledge Test
exams.blurb: 60-question test on airspace, weather, sectional charts, weight and balance and regulations for the private pilot certificate.

exams.name: Private Pilot Airplane Recreational Pilot Transition Knowledge Test
exams.blurb: 30-question bridging test for recreational pilots upgrading to a private pilot airplane certificate.

exams.name: Private Pilot Airship Knowledge Test
exams.blurb: 60-question test on airship buoyancy, envelope pressure, mooring and airspace rules for private airship pilots.

exams.name: Private Pilot Balloon Gas Knowledge Test
exams.blurb: 60-question test on gas balloon inflation, ballast, valve operation and weather for the private pilot balloon rating.

exams.name: Private Pilot Balloon Hot Air Knowledge Test
exams.blurb: 60-question test on hot air balloon systems, launch and landing site selection, surface winds and balloon regulations.

exams.name: Private Pilot Glider Knowledge Test
exams.blurb: 60-question test on glider aerodynamics, aerotow and winch launch procedures, thermals and airspace for glider pilots.

exams.name: Private Pilot Gyroplane Knowledge Test
exams.blurb: 60-question test covering gyroplane rotor systems, prerotation, performance limits and general aviation regulations.

exams.name: Private Pilot Gyroplane Recreational Pilot Transition Knowledge Test
exams.blurb: 30-question bridging test for recreational gyroplane pilots moving up to private pilot privileges.

exams.name: Private Pilot Helicopter Canadian Conversion Knowledge Test
exams.blurb: 40-question test converting a Canadian private helicopter licence into an FAA private pilot rotorcraft certificate.

exams.name: Private Pilot Helicopter Knowledge Test
exams.blurb: 60-question test on helicopter aerodynamics, height-velocity diagrams, weather and airspace for private rotorcraft pilots.

exams.name: Private Pilot Helicopter Recreational Pilot Transition Knowledge Test
exams.blurb: 30-question bridging test for recreational helicopter pilots upgrading to a private pilot rotorcraft certificate.

exams.name: Private Pilot Powered Parachute Knowledge Test
exams.blurb: 60-question test on powered parachute canopies, launch technique, wind limitations and airspace for private pilots.

exams.name: Private Pilot Weight-Shift-Control Knowledge Test
exams.blurb: 60-question test on weight-shift-control trike handling, performance, weather and regulations for private pilot applicants.

exams.name: Recreational Pilot Airplane Knowledge Test
exams.blurb: 50-question test for the recreational pilot certificate, which limits pilots to smaller aircraft and nearby airports.

exams.name: Recreational Pilot Gyroplane Knowledge Test
exams.blurb: 50-question test covering gyroplane basics and the operating limitations that apply to recreational pilot certificate holders.

exams.name: Recreational Pilot Helicopter Knowledge Test
exams.blurb: 50-question test on helicopter fundamentals and recreational pilot restrictions such as distance and passenger limits.

exams.name: Sport Pilot Airplane Knowledge Test
exams.blurb: 40-question test on light-sport aircraft limits, airspace, weather and regulations for the sport pilot certificate.

exams.name: Sport Pilot Glider Knowledge Test
exams.blurb: 40-question test on glider operations within sport pilot privileges, including launch methods and airspace rules.

exams.name: Sport Pilot Gyroplane Knowledge Test
exams.blurb: 40-question test covering gyroplane handling and the sport pilot operating limitations set out in Part 61 Subpart J.

exams.name: Sport Pilot Lighter-Than-Air Airship Knowledge Test
exams.blurb: 40-question test on light-sport airship operation, buoyancy control and sport pilot rules for lighter-than-air aircraft.

exams.name: Sport Pilot Lighter-Than-Air Balloon Knowledge Test
exams.blurb: 40-question test on balloon systems, launch site assessment and sport pilot privileges for lighter-than-air balloon pilots.

exams.name: Sport Pilot Powered Parachute Knowledge Test
exams.blurb: 40-question test on powered parachute operation, canopy inflation, surface wind limits and sport pilot regulations.

exams.name: Sport Pilot Weight-Shift-Control Knowledge Test
exams.blurb: 40-question test on weight-shift-control trike operation and sport pilot limitations on airspace, altitude and passengers.

exams.name: Unmanned Aircraft General Small Knowledge Test
exams.blurb: 60-question test on airspace, weather, loading and drone regulations required for the Part 107 remote pilot certificate.
